meta.title: feat(root): upgrade nx to latest version and remove legacy cache
meta.body_summary: Upgrade Nx from v20.3.0 to v21.0.4, update nx-cloud to 19.1.0, remove legacy cache from nx.json and runner configs, and adjust related build configuration.

perf_labels.notes: Devin performed Nx upgrade and cache config removal; PR closed without review or comment by maintainer scopsy, no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 83 changed lines across 3 commits, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It is a config-level upgrade that did not merge—the maintainer closed it without review, indicating low interest or insufficient justification for the version bump.

review_details.concern_detail: No review comments were provided; the PR was closed by maintainer without explanation.
review_details.performance_claim: Upgrading Nx and removing legacy cache would improve build performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer scopsy closed the PR 53 minutes after creation without any review comments; deploy preview failure may indicate instability, but no explicit rejection reason.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Build tool version upgrade is straightforward, but acceptance depends on repository version policies; closing without review suggests the change was not needed or lacked sufficient justification.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR claims testing by running build locally but provides no performance metrics or benchmark.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after deploy preview failure; no fix cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Upgrade package.json Nx version from 20.3.0 to 21.0.4 and nx-cloud to 19.1.0; rewrite nx.json and libs/automation/nx.json to remove legacy cache config and use nx-cloud runner; remove deprecated TypeScript option; add netlify.toml for dashboard staging.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The netlify config addition appears to be an attempt to fix a deploy failure, but the deploy still failed.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: upgrade Nx version and update configs.
Second commit: remove deprecated TypeScript option.
Third commit: add netlify configuration to fix dashboard deploy.

review_signals.summary: Devin bot introduction and auto-comment announcement.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with Nx upgrade and config changes.
Netlify bot reported deploy preview failure.
Maintainer scopsy closed PR without comment ~53 minutes later.
